jobs.title: Tech Infra Program Manager, Global Network Deployment (GND)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The successful candidate for this role will create sustainable processes and standards; and drive automation opportunities to reduce delivery cycle times and to improve quality without impacting network availability.  
  
The mission of the team is to deliver network capacity on time with zero rework. The GND Technical Program Manager will support the implementation and delivery of inbound capacity and equipment. They will be responsible for bringing efficiencies in operations and allow the team to scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Resolves Planning gaps by driving joint outcomes with stakeholder teams within GND.  
  
2. Owns identifying where systematic issues are blocking planner throughput, driving those to resolution across team boundaries.  
  
3. Collaborates on initiatives within GND that impact Planning (e.g. attend MBRs), and ensures that AMER, EMEA, and APAC regional teams are learning from each other rather than solving the same problems in silos.  
  
4. Provides forward visibility, surfacing risks before they become blockers, engaging the right decision-makers, and driving resolution so planners stay focused on planning and their time is not spent chasing other teams.  
  
5. Ensures solutions are grounded in how planners actually work, translating operational pain points into actionable requirements, representing planning in design discussions, and validating that what ships actually solves the problem.  
  
6. Owns how improvements land in the planning workflow - sequencing rollouts, enabling planners, and confirming that the change actually helps. Drives adoption of tools.  
  
7. Optimizes business processes through Agentic AI solutions.  
  
About the team  
\*Why AWS\*  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
\*Diverse Experiences\*  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
\*Work/Life Balance\*  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
\*Inclusive Team Culture\*  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
\*Mentorship and Career Growth\*  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
* Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Experience with AI/ML technologies
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. **Job Summary**  
Join the Defense Enclave Services (DES) program and help keep enterprise IT running for the Department of Defense Fourth Estate. DES supports the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) in delivering and sustaining enterprise IT services across DODNet.  
As the **Queue Manager / ITSM Operations Analyst**, you will oversee the incident and service request queues that support DODNet operations every day. You will make sure tickets are correctly prioritized, assigned, tracked, and resolved within service level agreements (SLAs) and contract performance standards. You will be the central coordination point for queue performance across supported teams. You will use ticket data to reduce backlogs, prevent avoidable SLA breaches, and give leadership clear, actionable reporting.  
**Location:** Fort Meade, MD  
**Clearance: Active Secret,** must be US Citizen  
  
**What’s in it for you:**

* Join a premier technology firm specializing in innovative solutions.
* Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative work culture.
* Enjoy tremendous growth potential in a high-performing team environment.
* A robust benefits package:
  + Health, dental, and vision insurance
  + Life insurance
  + Short-and-long term disability
  + Paid time off (PTO)
  + 401k retirement plan with employer match
  + Annual Professional Development Reimbursement Program
  + And more!

  
**What you will do:**  
Incident and Service Request Queue Management  

* Oversee incident and service request queues every day across User Support, Identity Management, and other supported service areas.
* Monitor ticket volume, priority, aging, assignment status, and resolution progress so tickets are acted on promptly.
* Find unassigned, misrouted, stalled, or aging tickets, and work with the right technical teams to correct them.
* Make sure tickets are properly categorized, prioritized, assigned, and managed from creation through closure.
* Work with technical leads and functional managers to balance workloads and address resource constraints.
* Set up and maintain processes for ticket escalation, reassignment, and follow-up.

Performance Monitoring and SLA Compliance

jobs.description:
The Institute for Defense Analyses (IDA) is seeking an experienced Research Analyst to join the Science, Systems, and Sustainment Division (S3D).

This role is for a researcher who is able to contribute to ongoing projects involving the technical details of satellite survivability and higher order effects on military operations and planning. Modeling and simulation experience is needed, plus the ability to derive actionable recommendations for government leaders, communicated in a clear manner. You will participate in and lead technically rigorous studies, develop new analytic approaches, and translate complex results into defensible insights for senior decision-makers.

Specific research-related activities expected of this position include:

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain relationships with potential sponsors and stakeholders in the national security community to identify emerging issues.
* Engage effectively with sponsors to understand their issues and constraints, and develop responsive research plans.
* Independently formulate research questions that address sponsors’ challenging and complex problems, and are informed by the broader context of national security.
* Identify key factors of the issue under study, and create and execute appropriate quantitative analytic methodologies, including novel computational and model-based approaches.
* Interact with government officials, military personnel, and other subject matter experts during the research process.
* Analyze, evaluate, and integrate data and model results with operational plans to understand impacts on the warfighter.
* Prepare reports and presentations documenting findings, conclusions, and recommendations and effectively communicate the results of IDA’s analysis to sponsors and selected audiences.

Required Qualifications

* Ph.D. in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative field with at least 3 years of relevant experience beyond academic work (e.g. industry, government, national lab, or other professional setting), or
* Master’s degree in one of the above fields with at least 8 years of relevant experience beyond academic work.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in small, high-performing, research teams.
* Strong technical communication skills, particularly the ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical audiences, including IDA collaborators and project leaders.
* Space Systems experience is desirable but not a requirement
* Significant interest in Department of War issues and military operations.
* Successful completion of a criminal background check is required.
* Travel (domestic or international) may be required.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI level security clearance. Having a current TS/SCI clearance is strongly desired.

The Research Environment

IDA research staff work on problems that do not have predefined solutions. Successful analysts are:

* Self-directed and intellectually curious.
* Comfortable working across disciplines.
* Able to contribute to multiple concurrent studies.
* Motivated by quantitative, high-consequence, analysis.

You will work with peers who value methodological rigor, independence of thought, and technical excellence.

**Why work at IDA?**

IDA, as a non-profit, is uniquely positioned to answer the most challenging U.S. security and science questions with objective and rigorous analysis leveraging extraordinary scientific, technical, and analytic expertise. This position is located in Alexandria, VA, just outside Washington, D.C.

IDA takes great pride in the high caliber and timeliness of its analyses, which are produced in a collegial atmosphere that encourages independent thinking, teamwork, and objective results. IDA provides an inclusive work environment and a comprehensive and competitive salary and benefits package.

What are the next steps?

* Complete the application and submit your resume.
* The application process consists of three interviews.

  + A short screening call with HR;
  + A 30 min – 60 min screening call with researchers; and
  + Full day interview with various researchers and staff; includes giving a presentation on a research project.

Prior to the full day interview, you will be asked to provide:

* Transcripts (unofficial accepted);
* 3 letters of recommendation; and
* A writing sample.

**Benefits**

At IDA, we pride ourselves on offering a comprehensive benefits package that ensures the well-being and security of our staff and their families. We provide a range of medical plans as well as stand-alone dental and vision coverage. Our retirement plans are designed to secure the financial future of our staff, featuring a generous contribution of 10% of base salary to our Qualified Retirement Plan after six months of service. We are committed to promoting a healthy work-life balance with a flexible work environment, an Employee Assistance Plan, paid parental leave, 10 paid holidays, and generous paid time off. IDA encourages professional development and offers tuition reimbursement and other learning opportunities. Learn more about our robust benefit offerings here.

**Pay**

jobs.description:

23 November 2026

Department

Analysis

Location(s)

West London

Salary

£41,843 per annum. Following the successful completion of your training, you’ll also be eligible for a Shift Disturbance Allowance of up to £8,085 per year and a Weekend Premium of £4,495 per year.

Job description

**Please note:** This is a full-time **shift-based role**, requiring you to work a rotating pattern of early, late and night shifts, including weekends. Your shift pattern will be fixed. While flexibility around shifts may be limited, we'll work with you wherever possible to support a healthy work-life balance and take account of responsibilities outside of work. Further information about the shift pattern will be shared with successful candidates.

**Flexible working:** Due to the nature of this role, flexible, home or remote working isn’t possible.

**About us**

MI5keeps the country safe from serious threats like terrorism and attempts by states to harm the UK, its people and way of life. We carry out investigations by obtaining, analysing and assessing intelligence, and then work with a range of partners, including MI6 and GCHQ to disrupt these threats. Through our protective security arm, we provide advice and guidance to government, businesses and other organisations about how to keep themselves safe. A role in MI5 means you’ll do unique and challenging work in a supportive and encouraging environment, making a real difference to UK national security.

**The role**  
Those who seek to harm the UK don’t work 9am to 5pm, so neither do we. Intelligence Operations Analysts gather information and provide a rapid response to operational teams working around the clock. We analyse data to identify serious and often hidden threats. You’ll work closely with colleagues across MI5 to understand their requirements and learn how to use our tools and techniques to assess a range of intelligence, including audio files, images and written communications, large data sets and location data.

The intelligence gathered doesn’t always reveal the full story. You’ll help unlock the details to determine what’s happening right now, whether it’s cause for concern, and what could happen next. You’ll analyse information as it becomes available from a range of sources, identify patterns and anomalies, and share your findings clearly and accurately to support operational decision-making.

Whether you’re on an early, late or night shift, you’ll be supporting live activity rather than building a picture over weeks or months, helping teams make decisions in the moment. And you won’t be doing it alone. The nature of the shifts and the importance of the work means we share a common goal and a real sense of camaraderie and team support. This is a role with real impact; the insight and connections you and your team provide could lead to major turning points in live investigations.

You’ll receive regular days off throughout your shift cycle, including extended periods away from work, plus dedicated personal development time. **Please note, you’ll need to be able to commute to West London and be ready to start work promptly for early shifts**.

**About you**

You might be a final year undergraduate or a recent graduate, returning to work after a break, looking for a career change or simply a new challenge. To apply, you'll have, or be expected to obtain by September 2027, a 2:2 degree or above in any subject **or** at least one year's full-time work experience using the core skills needed for analysis. Specific analyst experience isn’t required, but you should be able to demonstrate an ability to analyse information, data, evidence or trends. This may have come from your studies, work or everyday life.

Importantly, you’ll have an interest in innovation and enjoy solving problems and puzzles, or finding out what makes things work. So, you’ll be curious; someone who forms conclusions based on evidence. Resilience is key; you’ll be comfortable working at pace and under pressure as you’ll be supporting live activity as it unfolds. You might not always get the right answer from what you’re analysing, so you’ll stay focused, patient and adapt to changing demands and intricate problems as required.

Collaboration is critical. You might be understanding unique requirements, communicating complex analytics to non-technical colleagues, writing handover notes at the end of your shift, or presenting your findings. You’ll be clear and to-the-point, especially when working on something time-sensitive. At all times, you’ll combine attention to detail with sound judgement in time-critical scenarios.

Please note that there is a hearing test as part of the application process. This is because the role will involve listening to audio files. If you wear hearing aids, you’ll be able to complete the test using them.

To perform roles effectively across MI5, employees need to be able to understand information provided in English, including emails, workplace communications and other work-related documents; communicate in English as part of meetings and discussions; and produce and respond to written communications in English relevant to their role.

**Training and development**

The role is designed to provide a strong foundation for a long-term career in intelligence analysis.Upon joining, you’ll undertake a three-month training period combining classroom learning with practical experience alongside experienced operational analysis teams. During training, you’ll work standard Monday to Friday office hours, while developing the skills, techniques and confidence needed for the role. Shift and weekend allowances begin once training has been successfully completed.

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
PGI is a global consultancy that helps organisations build digital resilience. We deploy our people to implement solutions on behalf of clients or to support them in developing their own capabilities. Our vision is a world resilient to digital threats and online harm. To achieve this, we need to grow our team of talented and passionate people. Our clients include some of the most well-known global brands, national governments, and innovative growing businesses. We operate in an exciting, fast-growing sector that bears increasing relevance and importance to nation-states, corporates, universities, and NGOs.

#### **What you'll be doing**

PGI’s threat intelligence functions continue to expand, driving our successful growth. As a Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analyst, you will track threat actors, campaigns and criminal ecosystems, and turn findings into actionable intelligence for clients. The responsibilities of the post are as follows:

* Lead CTI engagements, owning analytic direction and output quality, and acting as senior analytical point of contact for clients.
* Produce strategic and tactical CTI products, from executive-level assessments that draw together cyber, physical and geopolitical indicators to actor profiles, threat landscapes and alerts, tailored to each client’s requirements.
* Monitor and research threat actors, including ransomware and extortion groups, initial access brokers, hacktivists and state-linked actors.
* Collect, enrich and pivot on technical indicators to attribute activity and uncover wider campaigns.
* Identify client exposure, including leaked credentials, breaches, brand impersonation, lookalike domains and attack surface weaknesses, escalating urgent issues promptly.
* Work with clients to define and refine priority intelligence requirements (PIRs), and present findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Apply rigorous analytic standards: source evaluation, confidence language and clear separation of fact, assessment and judgement, and act as a peer reviewer for other analysts’ work through our QA process.
* Build and improve our collection, enrichment and threat actor tracking tools and workflows, including responsible use of AI for tasks.
* Design and deliver table-top exercises and training that take clients through realistic threat scenarios.
* Mentor junior analysts, sharing tradecraft and raising analytic standards.
* Contribute to proposals and thought leadership.

#### **One day one you will bring**

* At least five years’ experience in cyber threat intelligence or threat research, ideally in a consultancy, government, intelligence or security vendor environment, including leading projects and mentoring or reviewing other analysts’ work.
* Deep understanding of the threat landscape, including attack techniques, the cybercrime economy, state-linked activity and emerging AI-enabled threats such as deepfake and identity fraud.
* Excellent written English, with experience producing concise, well-evidenced assessments for both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to build or automate collection and enrichment tooling (e.g. Python), and familiarity with CTI platforms and indicator analysis.
* Experience researching safely in dark web and closed-source environments, with sound OPSEC and discretion with sensitive information.
* Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and structured analytic techniques, and the ability to express confidence and uncertainty clearly.
* Desirable: experience designing and delivering training or table-top exercises; disinformation or influence operations analysis; malware or blockchain analysis; relevant certifications (e.g. GCTI, CREST CPTIA, OSIP); additional languages relevant to the threat landscape.
* Eligible for SC clearance and willing to undergo vetting.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at PGI**

As a British company which operates internationally, we draw strength from the diversity of our people. Without our diverse team, we couldn’t do the work we do. We are involved in projects across 80+ geographies, our people speak 25+ languages and come from a variety of backgrounds. By hiring and cultivating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, we can uphold values that enable every member of the team to thrive, while delivering novel solutions to novel problems.

**Accessibility at PGI**

Every individual has different requirements, so we are committed to implementing reasonable adjustments to mitigate physical and non-physical barriers in the workplace.

We strive to make the recruitment process as accessible as possible, but if you have any questions or concerns, please get in touch.

***Please note:*** *We are not accepting applications or speculative profiles from any recruitment agencies. If we require additional resource, we will reach out to you.*

Rail Delivery Group (RDG) partners with Britain’s train operators to put customers at the heart of everything we do, delivering essential services and dedicated experts who keep the nation’s railway running efficiently.

From journey information, reservations and Railcards to improving performance, safety and accessibility, we drive the services and people that keep the railway moving. The role requires strong stakeholder engagement across a complex, multi-organisational environment. ------------------

Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We spun out of Peppy Health to take on what we believe is the biggest untouched opportunity in enterprise software.

Global employers spend $3–5 trillion on benefits every year. It is their second-largest cost after payroll, yet the category still runs on legacy systems and spreadsheets. Incumbents cannot move fast enough, and AI-first startups have mostly overlooked it.

We have two products:

* **GAP (Global Administration Platform)** for global benefits teams. It uses LLMs to parse and extract policy documents into a structured ontology, and gives admins spend and utilisation tools across every country they operate in.
* **Navigator**, the employee-facing product that helps people understand and use their benefits.

We are post product-market fit at seed stage, live with some of the world's largest household-name enterprises, and we land and expand country by country. Our big current focus is flexible benefits and open enrollment. We stay deliberately lean so that the people who join own a meaningful piece of what we build.

This is also genuine tech for good: better benefits administration directly improves the wellbeing and financial security of millions of employees.

**The Role**

As a **Senior** **Deployment Strategist** you will spend roughly 80% of your time on client work and 20% on developing our products. You will own a portfolio of approximately 1 to 3 enterprise accounts, depending on size, from post-sale through live launch and beyond.

This is not a project management role. With the Euphoric MCP you will build custom agents, automations and workflows for some of the world's largest employers. You will be on the edge of AI in the workplace, guiding how global enterprises roll AI out to their benefits teams and employees.

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

No two weeks are the same as a **Senior** **Deployment Strategist**, but you can expect to:

* **Own your accounts end to end.** Be the named owner for approximately 1 to 3 enterprise clients, depending on size, from post-sale handover through implementation, live launch, renewal and expansion into new countries.
* **Drive land and expand.** Configure demos and the actual product for potential expansions, from new countries to new employee populations, so clients see working product, not slides.
* **Deliver deployments.** Configure GAP and Navigator for each client, build implementation plans, run UAT, manage data and policy-document onboarding, handle support and track adoption on live data.
* **Go on site.** Spend real time with clients' benefits and HR teams, including regional rollouts and country launches. On average expect around 1 day a week on client site; it varies, with heavier weeks around launches and occasional international travel as our clients expand globally.
* **Lead workshops and train clients.** Run discovery and design workshops, and train client teams so they get full value from GAP and Navigator.
* **Build with the Euphoric MCP.** Design and ship custom agents, automations and workflows that solve each client's specific problems, from reporting and renewals to employee communications.
* **Run the relationship.** Be the day-to-day contact, write clear client emails, and build the decks, QBRs and proposals that move senior stakeholders, from benefits administrators up to global heads of reward.
* **Shape the product (~20%).** Work closely with core product, engineering and design to build out specific features and flows your accounts need. Bring field insight back so it becomes part of the core platform.
* **Step into product when it's quieter.** In weeks where client work is less intense, you are fully expected to support in a product capacity: specs, evals, prompts, testing and analytics.
* **Work hand in hand with Deployed Product Managers.** They will join you on site to learn how to improve the core product. You will own the client-specific work.

**Skills & Experience**
-----------------------

* **4+ years of enterprise deployment experience.** You have delivered enterprise-level client implementations in a B2B SaaS environment and handled difficult stakeholders along the way. This is essential.
* **Extremely AI-pilled.** You have a genuine, intense interest in AI and you build with it constantly: Claude Code, Cowork, Cursor, Codex, MCP integrations and agents. You will be asked to show your latest AI projects. This matters more than anything else.
* **A builder.** You want to build, not just advise. You are comfortable with APIs, data models and prompts, and you build agents and automations on clients' behalf yourself rather than writing a ticket for someone else.
* **Academically excellent.** You have an exceptional academic track record from a top university, with strong A-levels or equivalent. A STEM degree is desirable but not essential.
* **A strong communicator.** Your emails are crisp, your decks land after a few iterations, and you can explain technical ideas to non-technical audiences, up to senior executives.
* **High ownership.** You treat your accounts as your own business, follow through without being chased, and do what it takes on launch weeks.
* **A proven high performer.** You can point to reaching the top of something demanding: unusually fast promotion, elite sport or music, or national or international academic awards.

**What We Look For:**
---------------------

We have a few Euphoric cultural non-negotiables. To do well here you will:

* Thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance, feedback-rich environment.
* Take your work seriously, but not yourself.
* Be proactive, playful and deeply curious.
* Want to build something that *matters*.

**What You’ll Get:**
--------------------

* Salary between £90k-£110k.
* Meaningful early-stage equity.
* Private medical insurance with Vitality, including dental and op

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

Based within the Information Security team, the Information Security Analyst will be working closely with the Head of Information Security, the delivery team and key business stakeholders. This role combines information security and GRC consultancy with hands-on configuration and implementation of the OneTrust platform.

This role will be involved in:

* Implementing and supporting IT Risk Management and Third Party Risk Management projects using OneTrust.
* Supporting clients with ISO 27001 ISMS implementation and compliance services.
* Providing practical information security, risk and GRC advice to clients.
* Undertaking multiple projects in all areas of information management including information security, data protection and information governance.

**Responsibilities**

**Client Delivery**

* Support the delivery of client information security, GRC, IT Risk Management and Third Party Risk Management engagements.
* Configure and implement OneTrust GRC solutions to meet client requirements, including assessments, attributes, workflows and related platform functionality.
* Support clients with the implementation and ongoing operation of ISO 27001 Information Security Management Systems (ISMS).

* Deliver training, presentations and education on information security topics and the OneTrust platform.

**Risk, Assurance and Compliance**

* Support clients with IT risk and third-party risk management, including the identification, assessment, documentation and treatment of information security and cyber risks.

* Build effective working relationships with client stakeholders, internal teams and third-party suppliers.

**Internal Information Security**

* Maintain Oyster IMS Policy Management processes through OneTrust, including monitoring policy publication and attestation.
* Administer and support the Phished platform in partnership with the internal Support Team, including phishing simulations, awareness activity and testing of internal processes.

**Essential**

* Able to explain complex security, risk and regulatory requirements clearly and practically.
* Confident working with senior stakeholders and able to influence decisions appropriately.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the judgement to propose proportionate, workable solutions.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively with individuals and teams on both planned and ad-hoc activities.
* Resilient and comfortable challenging assumptions or decisions constructively when required.

**Desirable**

* Experience configuring OneTrust Third Party Risk Management, IT Risk Management, Compliance Automation and/or Enterprise Policy Management modules.

jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

 Plan, lead and manage the end-to-end ISO/IEC 27001 program, including ISMS scope definition, timelines, budget, resources and stakeholder reporting.

 Review existing information security policies, standards, procedures and records to assess completeness and alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27002.

 Examine current security practices and controls across people, processes and technology to evaluate how effectively they operate in practice.

 Conduct a detailed gap analysis against ISO/IEC 27001 requirements (Clauses 4–10 and Annex A controls) and produce a prioritized remediation roadmap.

 Develop and maintain the information security risk management methodology, and conduct periodic technical risk assessments of applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services and medical and clinical systems.

 Maintain the information security risk register and risk treatment plans, and track the implementation of treatments with risk and control owners.

 Coordinate periodic vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and configuration reviews, and ensure findings are risk-rated, remediated and verified.

 Establish and manage a CIS-based compliance program, adopting the CIS Critical Security Controls (v8) and CIS Benchmarks as secure configuration baselines for operating systems, databases, network devices, cloud platforms and applications.

 Conduct periodic CIS compliance assessments using automated scanning tools (e.g., CIS-CAT Pro, Tenable, Qualys), track compliance scores against agreed targets, and coordinate remediation or documented exceptions with system owners.

 Prepare and maintain the Statement of Applicability (SoA) and the documentation required for the ISMS, including the ISMS scope, policy, objectives and supporting procedures.

 Assess information security risks of third parties and suppliers, and ensure appropriate security requirements are included in contracts.

 Establish and run the ISMS internal audit program and management reviews, and track

non conformities and corrective actions through to closure.

 Prepare CLIENT for Stage 1 and Stage 2 re-certification audits and ongoing surveillance audits, coordinate with the certification body, and lead the response to any findings.

 Define information security KPIs and metrics, and generate and present periodic (monthly and quarterly) reports covering risk posture, control effectiveness, vulnerability and remediation status, CIS compliance scores, security incidents, audit findings and awareness completion, to support management reviews and decision-making.

 Drive information security awareness and training so that staff understand their responsibilities within the ISMS.

 Ensure the ISMS aligns with CLIENT policies and applicable UAE and Dubai Government information security and data protection requirements, including the UAE Information Assurance Standards, Dubai Electronic Security Center (DESC) requirements and healthcare data regulations.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

 Support the implementation, maintenance and certification of the IT Service Management System (ISO/IEC 20000-1) and the Business Continuity Management System (ISO 22301), working closely with the IT Service Management and Business Continuity teams.

 Contribute to business impact analysis (BIA), the definition of recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) and continuity risk assessments for critical IT services and information assets.

 Support the development, review and testing of IT service continuity, disaster recovery and business continuity plans, and ensure lessons learned are captured and acted upon.

 Identify opportunities for an integrated management system across ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including shared policies, documentation, internal audits and management reviews.

 Support internal and external audits for ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including evidence preparation and follow-up of corrective actions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.

 [7–10]+ years of experience in information security, including at least [3] years leading ISMS, security risk or compliance programs.

 Proven track record of leading at least one ISO/IEC 27001 implementation or certification.

 In-depth knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27002 and ISO/IEC 27005, and of risk

assessment methodologies.

 Hands-on experience implementing and assessing the CIS Critical Security Controls and CIS Benchmarks, including the use of configuration compliance scanning tools.

 Solid technical understanding of networks, operating systems, cloud platforms, identity and access management, and security technologies (e.g., firewalls, SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners).

 Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301; hands-on implementation or audit experience with these standards is a strong advantage.

 Familiarity with UAE and Dubai information security regulations and healthcare data protection requirements.

 Experience in healthcare or government environments is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

 CISSP, CISM or CISA

 ISO/IEC 20000-1 and/or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (advantageous)

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Manufacturing Operations exists to build and sustain the production system that enables Anduril to scale manufacturing with speed, quality, and discipline. We don't just support the factory. We are the operating system that makes it run. Our remit spans five pillars: the Anduril Production System (standard work, tiered accountability, KPIs, visual management), optimization and continuous improvement, learning and development, maintenance standards, and analytics. This role reports directly to the VP of Manufacturing Operations.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As Manufacturing Program Manager you will drive the cross-functional projects and initiatives that move Anduril from LRIP-era operations to a scalable Full Rate Production model. You will not own a single product line. Instead, you will be the program management engine across all five pillars of the Manufacturing Operations remit, ensuring that strategic initiatives have clear owners, defined timelines, cross-functional alignment, and measurable outcomes.

This is not a traditional project management role. It requires someone who understands manufacturing operations at the floor level and can drive accountability across engineering, supply chain, quality, IT, and leadership to get programs across the finish line.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

You will drive cross-functional projects and initiatives within each of the five areas that define the Manufacturing Operations remit:

**Build and Deploy the Anduril Production System**

* Drive the cross-functional rollout of standard work, tiered meeting structures (Tier 1/2/3), KPI definitions, and visual management across all manufacturing site
* Coordinate across Manufacturing System & Standards, site leadership, and IT/Digital to sequence deployment line by line and ensure each site is assessed, baselined, and brought to standard
* Build and operationalize the enterprise scorecard architecture (Plan vs. Actual, CTB Attainment, Downtime Pareto, Yield/DRR, OT%) so each level of the organization has the right metric at the right cadence
* Stand up and manage the Leadership SteerCo cadence that governs system priorities and holds the standard

**Get Technicians to Certified Operator Faster**

* Program manage the initiatives that cut time-from-hire-to-certified-operator, partnering with L&D on structured onboarding, skill certification redesign, and OJT overhaul
* Drive the cross-functional work between L&D, Talent Acquisition, and state/community partners (e.g., JobsOhio) to build a repeatable technician sourcing and hiring pipeline
* Ensure standard work is right-sized and OJT checklists map 1:1 to tasks so qualification is verifiable at every technician level
* Track and report on onboarding volume, certification timelines, and pipeline health across all sites

**Upskill Key Front-Line Leaders**

* Drive the buildout and cross-site deployment of supervisor and leadership training programs so the leaders closest to the line can run and audit the production system themselves
* Coordinate between L&D, site leadership, and the Optimization team to deliver leadership content and embed real-time coaching and mentoring across all sites
* Track program delivery milestones, cohort completions, and effectiveness metrics for Lead, Own, Grow and future leadership curricula

**Support and Optimize the Lines We Run**

* Coordinate the deployment of CI and optimization resources across sites, sequencing stabilization and optimization work against business impact
* Manage the CI project portfolio: track active deployments, gap assessments, kaizen events, and value stream mapping initiatives to ensure knowledge transfer sticks after each engagement
* Drive cross-functional alignment on NPI manufacturing readiness so new programs reach rate faster, partnering with Manufacturing Engineering and site teams
* Coordinate surge and recovery support when lines need additional capacity, ensuring the right resources deploy with clear scope and exit criteria

**Build Maintenance into the System**

* Drive the cross-functional standup of maintenance as a discipline within the production system: preventative maintenance programs, spare parts strategy, work order management, and technician skill development
* Coordinate the integration of maintenance KPIs (uptime, MTBF, MTTR, PM completion rate) into site-level scorecards and tiered meetings
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to define and document handoff criteria in the MDP/Launch Playbook so maintenance boundaries are clear from day one

**Across all five pillars:**

* Own the interfaces between Manufacturing Operations and partner organizations (Quality, ME, Supply Chain, IT/Digital, EHS) to keep boundary agreements current and escalation paths clear
* Standardize the work product for all outward reporting on behalf of Manufacturing Operations, ensuring leadership has consistent, quantitative visibility into program status, risks, and outcomes
* Drive resolution on open cross-functional governance questions (production scheduling ownership, shop-floor safety program ownership, MES system of record)

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon buys from hundreds of thousands of suppliers worldwide. Do you want to build one trusted view of who they are, and make that data ready for AI to reason and act on at global scale? As a Technical Program Manager on the Global Procurement Technology team, you will lead the supplier data programs at the center of Amazon's procurement AI transformation. You will drive the Supplier Mapping Framework, an AI-powered entity-resolution platform that unifies supplier identities and spend across systems. You will also drive Supplier 360, the supplier profile and search experience that procurement teams and AI applications across Amazon rely on.  
  
You will own roadmaps and delivery end to end. That means turning ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, setting data-quality and governance mechanisms, and aligning upstream data owners and downstream consumers across organizations. You will partner with software engineers, data engineers, scientists, business intelligence engineers and business stakeholders to launch reliable data products that shape sourcing, risk and spend decisions worldwide. If you enjoy driving clarity through ambiguity and want your programs to influence procurement strategy globally, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the end-to-end roadmap, requirements and delivery for the Supplier Mapping Framework and Supplier 360, from problem definition through launch and adoption.
* Turn ambiguous business needs from category management, sourcing, supplier risk and audit teams into clear requirements, phased plans and measurable success metrics.
* Drive data-quality and governance mechanisms, such as match accuracy, coverage reporting and source-of-truth validation, so supplier data can be trusted for decisions and AI applications.
* Align upstream data owners and downstream consumers across organizations on dependencies, data access, compliance requirements and launch timelines.
* Lead operational excellence for production data and AI systems, including launch readiness, metrics reviews, incident follow-up and continuous improvement.

  
A day in the life  
Your day balances collaboration with focused time, and you'll work with engineering teams and stakeholders across time zones. Then you might sync with engineers on a launch dependency, or work through a requirements question with a supplier risk or audit partner. The rhythm gives you regular cross-time-zone collaboration balanced with dedicated heads-down hours each day.  
  
About the team  
Global Procurement Technology sits within Global Procurement Operations and builds the data and technology products that power Amazon's procurement processes worldwide. Our key products include the supplier mapping framework, the trusted supplier data repository, and the supplier management system. The team is an agile group of data engineers, software engineers, scientists, and product and program managers, with Principal Engineers in the broader organization providing technical guidance. jobs.title: Financial Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**ABOUT CIM GROUP:**

CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today!

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

The Financial Data Analyst owns the ongoing integrity of the financial and performance data CIM relies on for investor reporting, internal decision-making, and business planning. To start, the scope of data for this position will include investment performance across CIM’s funds, separately managed accounts, and co-investment vehicles, and will extend over time to other financial analytics such as FP&A, forecasting, and fund accounting outputs. Metrics are produced through automated processes; the Financial Data Analyst is accountable for every reporting cycle’s controls that keep them accurate. This role will continuously improve control coverage and automation as funds, methodologies, and the data platform evolve. The Financial Data Analyst owns validation logic and control operation and will partner closely with Data Engineering as the primary owners of pipeline infrastructure. This is a hands-on, analytical and technical role for someone with expertise in financial and performance data in alternative investments and an explicit interest in leading ongoing governance and controls.

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Data Validation & Continuous Control Improvement**

* Own automated validation of performance metrics (IRR, TWR, MOIC, DPI, RVPI, TVPI) across funds, SMAs, and co-investment vehicles, running and monitoring controls every reporting cycle.
* Extend the control framework to additional financial analytics — including budgets, forecasts, cash projections, and fund accounting outputs.
* Maintain validation rules and tolerances — reasonableness checks, variance thresholds, cross-metric consistency (for example, DPI + RVPI = TVPI), and independent recalculation — and recalibrate them as exception patterns and structures change.
* Operate automated reconciliations to NAV, general ledger, and capital accounts; manage exceptions to resolution and fix the root causes of recurring issues.
* Track control performance — exception rates, false positives, resolution time, and automation coverage — and use it to prioritize ongoing improvements.
* Maintain data lineage from reported figures to source systems.
* Apply documented performance methodologies as testable logic, and propose a recommended treatment for edge cases (such as DPI netting, broken deals, and recycled capital) for the methodology owner’s decision.
* Perform variance analysis and attribution, and explain the drivers of results in clear, documented narratives.

**Governance & Controls**

* Run governance and control routines each reporting cycle, test their effectiveness periodically, and refine control design based on the results.
* Maintain a living control inventory — what is checked, how often, and who is accountable — with supporting evidence.
* Contribute to the Track Record Policy Change Operating Process, and update validation rules and regression tests for each approved change.
* Work with Data Engineering on pipeline enhancements, test coverage, and release controls.
* Partner with Compliance and Legal to support regulatory requirements for track record presentations, including the SEC Marketing Rule.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation for internal reviews, external audits, DDQ responses, and LP inquiries.

**Financial Analysis & Reporting Support**

* Provide the financial analysis behind investor reporting and DDQ responses, keeping figures and disclosures consistent across materials.
* Maintain analytical models, reconciliations, and templates, and convert manual, repetitive steps into controlled, repeatable processes.
* Partner with Fund Accounting, FP&A, Portfolio Oversight, Investments, and Investor Relations to resolve discrepancies and align reported figures.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 3–6 years in performance measurement, fund accounting, FP&A, investment analytics, controls, or financial analysis. Experience in alternative investments is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of performance metrics and methodologies, including IRR, TWR, MOIC, DPI, RVPI, TVPI, and attribution.
* Proficiency in SQL for querying source data, reconciling outputs, and building automated validation checks.
* Experience operating and improving automated reconciliation, data quality, or controls frameworks, or testing financial calculations.
* Demonstrated ability to own a recurring reporting cycle (such as quarter-close) alongside a standing improvement backlog.
* Strong financial analysis skills and advanced Excel.
* Attention to detail, a skeptical mindset, and clear communication — including explaining why a number moved.

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Python or PySpark for validation logic; Databricks or a comparable lakehouse platform; Domo or another BI tool for control reporting.
* Familiarity with version control, code review, and automated testing.
* Alternatives, real estate, or infrastructure asset management experience, including quarter-close and investor-reporting cycles.
* Exposure to FP&A, forecasting, or budgeting processes.
* Familiarity with GIPS, NCREIF / PREA, INREV, ILPA, the SEC Marketing Rule, and DDQ processes.
* CFA Level I or II passed, or the CAIA designation (in progress or completed).

### **EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics

**BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions** est le métier spécialisé dans les solutions de financement locatif d’équipements professionnels et immobiliers. Présent dans 20 pays, il accompagne les entreprises dans le développement de leurs activités grâce à l’expertise de près de 3 700 collaborateurs.

Au sein de la Fonction RISK de BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions, vous rejoindrez l’équipe **Scoring & Provisioning Models**. Cette équipe est notamment chargée de la conception, de la maintenance et de l’industrialisation des modèles quantitatifs utilisés pour évaluer le risque de crédit, tant dans le cadre de l’octroi que du provisionnement.

**AU QUOTIDIEN ÇA DONNE QUOI ?**
--------------------------------

Dans un contexte de renforcement des outils de pilotage, vous contribuerez à la conception et à l’industrialisation d’un dispositif de suivi des ratings des partenaires. Vous participerez également à l’amélioration et à la sécurisation de l’environnement Power BI de l’équipe.

**À ce titre, vous serez amené à :**

* Recueillir et formaliser les besoins des utilisateurs en matière d’indicateurs, d’axes d’analyse, de filtres et de fréquence de mise à jour ;
* Identifier, consolider et contrôler les différentes sources de données nécessaires au suivi des ratings partenaires ;
* Définir, en collaboration avec les équipes métiers, les indicateurs clés permettant notamment d’analyser la répartition et l’évolution des ratings, les migrations, les concentrations et la qualité des données ;
* Concevoir des tableaux de bord Power BI clairs, interactifs et adaptés aux différents niveaux de lecture, du suivi opérationnel à la synthèse managériale ;
* Automatiser les traitements, les contrôles et le rafraîchissement des données afin de fiabiliser les reportings et de réduire les opérations manuelles ;
* Documenter les sources de données, les règles de gestion, les indicateurs et les procédures de mise à jour ;
* Participer à l’administration de l’environnement Power BI, notamment à travers l’organisation des espaces de travail, la publication des tableaux de bord et le suivi de leur cycle de vie ;
* Contribuer à la gestion des accès, à la ségrégation des droits et à l’amélioration du processus d’habilitation.

**Votre stage se déroulera** dans les locaux de BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions, situés au **18 rue Baudin à Levallois-Perret**, à proximité du métro Pont de Levallois.

Ce stage est à pourvoir pour une **durée de 06 mois**, avec un démarrage souhaité en **mars ou avril 2027**.

**ET APRÈS ?**
--------------

Grâce à cette expérience, vous développerez vos compétences en matière de data visualisation, de data storytelling, de modélisation des données et d’automatisation des reportings. Vous approfondirez également votre compréhension des enjeux liés à la qualité des données, à la gouvernance des accès et au pilotage du risque de crédit.

Un package et des avantages :

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About Alma**

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

### **About the team**

Revenue at Alma covers the entire customer lifecycle, from lead generation to churn. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.

Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. The team supports Revenue leaders in improving performance, making better decisions and scaling the organisation.

This position is a permanent contract, based in Paris, with 2 days of remote work per week.

You will report to Gaspard Zhâ, and work closely with Revenue teams, the Central Data Team, Ops & Risk, Product and Tech.

### **About the job**

As Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, you will create strategic insights that help Alma's Revenue teams understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.

You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.

Key responsibilities :

**Own the modelling / end-to-end pipeline for Revenue teams**

* Built models to answer the needs of revenue teams, by adding additional data sources
* Improve and maintain the existing models

**Feed our strategy and participate to its execution**

* Understand reasons of wins and how to win faster by making our data speak
* Design adhoc data driven tools and models to crack tactical business cases

**Improve performance monitoring and understanding of revenue growth dynamics**

* Build and manage dashboards and revenue forecasts so Revenue teams and leadership can easily understand business health and meet goals
* Support leaders of Revenue teams to set the right targets and follow the right KPIs

**Infuse data excellence**

* Driving a data culture inside revenue teams, leveraging data as to build unfair advantages
* Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain a high standard on data quality across the organization

### **You will work with**

SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce

### **About you**

To succeed in this job

* Strong proficiency in **SQL** and data modelling
* **2 to 4 years experience in data analysis/business analysis**, preferably in a fast-growing tech or fintech environment
* Strong proficiency in data visualisation, strong plus to have already work *with Looker & LookML*
* Genuine curiosity and eagerness to **work with AI-assisted tools** (Claude Code) as part of your daily workflo

And it will be nice if you also

* Are comfortable with **Python** for data manipulation and analysis
* Have hands-on experience with **dbt, BigQuery, or GCP**
* Have worked with **tracking tools** such as Rudderstack (or Segment)
* Hold a degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or similar

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

### **Your Alma experience**

The culture

At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.

You will have access to our Learning & Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.

We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.

The role itself

If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:

* Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.
* Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
* Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

### **Compensation & benefits**

* **Competitive salary** based on 12 months
* **Profit-sharing and employee savings plan**
* **Health insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma, including family package
* **Disability insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma
* **Sport**: partnerships with **Gymlib** and **ClassPass**, or **€30/month** reimbursement for your sports activities
* **Maternity/paternity leave**: salary maintained at 100% during leave, with no seniority requirement. Return to work at a 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks
* **Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD)**: **€544.80/year**, excluding full-remote contracts
* **Meal vouchers**: **€10/day**, 50% covered by Alma
* **Mental health**: free access to the MindDay platform
* **Paid time off**: 25 days per year, plus additional paid leave granted to employees on executive contracts
* Access to our **Learning & Development Platform**
* **2 weeks of full remote work possible per year** during the summer

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Operations Manager**

Rental Operations- Hayward, CA

**About Med One Group:**

Med One Group, a leader in the medical equipment rental and finance industry for over 25 years, is seeking a self-motivated Operations Manager to lead our distribution warehouse in Hayward, CA. This is a full-time, salaried position with a starting base salary of $80,000-$95,000, depending on experience.

In this role, you will oversee day-to-day warehouse operations while partnering closely with the Sales team to ensure exceptional customer service and operational excellence. The Operations Manager provides leadership, direction, and development to a team responsible for medical equipment processing, delivery coordination, scheduling, inventory management, and customer service.

**Essential Functions:**

* Thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Establish clear, measurable goals aligned with organizational objectives, ensuring strong alignment between people, processes, and strategy to drive consistent execution.
* Set high performance standards, hold teams accountable, and ensure full compliance with all policies and procedures.
* Lead by example by demonstrating a positive, committed approach to the business, colleagues, cross-functional partners, direct reports, and clients.
* Collaborate with Sales and leadership to deliver customer-focused, win-win solutions.
* Build and strengthen customer relationships in close partnership with the Sales team.
* Oversee facility operations, including warehouse and office organization, cleanliness, supply inventory, coordination with home office IT, business licenses, and relationships with local property management.
* Apply strong business and financial acumen by managing contracts and overseeing Profit & Loss (P&L) statements and budgets to support account profitability.
* Drive continuous improvement across processes, products, and services while embracing innovation, change, and adaptability.
* Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and emergency off-hours as business needs require.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to after-hours calls as needed to support staff and operations.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in warehouse operations, operations management, or a supervisory role.
* 3 to 5 years of leadership experience with a demonstrated ability to motivate teams, work independently, and take initiative. Experience in the medical equipment rental industry is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to build relationships and deliver excellent customer service.
* Proficiency with PC-based applications, excellent organizational skills, and strong attention to detail.

**Additional Information:**

Med One offers a great work environment with a team of dedicated coworkers who take pride in what they do. We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as a Health Savings Account partially funded by Med One. Additional benefits include life insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) plan through Vanguard, which employees are eligible to contribute to beginning on the first of the month following 30 days of employment. After one year of service, Med One matches 401(k) contributions up to 5%. We also offer paid time off, holiday pay, and a quarterly performance-based bonus.

If you're a motivated leader who thrives in a collaborative, customer-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Certification Operations and Policy Program Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Success - San Francisco

**About the Team**

Customer Education helps customers build the practical skills and confidence to use AI and OpenAI products safely and effectively. We bring together customer insight, learning and enablement expertise, product signals, and measurement to help organizations move from access to durable adoption.

Within Customer Education, the Certification team helps individuals demonstrate competence for in-demand AI skills and helps customers and partners validate that their workforce has the skills they need to meet their AI-enabled business goals. Our work centers on the belief that learners should understand where to go to build skills and capabilities, how to demonstrate them, and what to pursue next. Similarly, Enterprise leaders should understand what each credential signifies and how it supports workforce readiness. We do this with transparency for the overall OpenAI credential framework and providing trusted, role-based certifications that verify practical capability.

**About the Role**

As Certification Operations and Policy Program Manager, you will build and run the processes that make OpenAI certifications accessible, fair, and reliable for candidates and the organizations that rely on them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role on the Certification team, with no direct reports. You will define candidate policies, turn them into practical processes, and own their implementation as the program grows. This is not a general program-management or support-only role: it combines policy development with hands-on operational delivery.

You will work closely with the Certification team, product and technical teams, Legal, Privacy, Security, Accessibility, Support, and delivery vendors to define operational standards and apply policies consistently and fairly. You will connect the partners needed to turn certification requirements into workable candidate processes.

You will start with early certification launches and build reusable playbooks, service standards, and review processes for live and virtual delivery. Initially, you will also triage escalated vendor and candidate cases, resolve routine delivery or credential-access issues, and route substantive appeals through the established independent-review process.

Success means candidates know what to expect, delivery partners know what to do when something goes wrong, and sensitive decisions are documented and independently reviewed.

**In this role, you will:**

* Define candidate-facing policies and communications across the certification journey, including eligibility, registration, exam rules, retakes, exceptions, expiration, and renewal. Partner with the Certification team to translate program requirements into policy and with Legal, product, technical teams, and vendors to build the processes that uphold it.
* Own the accommodations process from request through delivery. Work with Accessibilityation throughout.
* Own certification records and evidence workflows teams.
* Own vendor workflows and operational delivery standards, including handoffs, service levels, readiness checks, and escalation paths. Initially serve as the first point of contact for escalated delivery and credential-access cases, coordinating vendor fixes, candidate communications, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate the response to exam integrity incidents, including suspected cheating, impersonation, or unauthorized sharing of exam content. * Have managed external delivery vendors against service standards and followed through when those standards were not met.

* Have resolved time-sensitive operational issues within established policy and escalated exceptions to the appropriate decision-makers.
* Have applied accessibility, fairness, and credential-integrity policies consistently in candidate-facing operations.

jobs.title: Senior Billing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Druva**

Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.
  
  
Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

**Role Purpose & Impact**

The Senior Billing Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of customer billing activities. This position is responsible for managing complex billing transactions, reviewing contractual requirements, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining compliance with company policies and accounting standards.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented professional with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a solid understanding of order-to-cash processes, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

In addition to daily billing operations, the Senior Billing Analyst will help identify opportunities for process improvement, strengthen internal controls, and leverage emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools, to drive automation, enhance operational efficiency, and support scalable billing processes.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Sales Order Processing and Billing Operations**

* Process sales orders and customer invoices accurately and timely using Salesforce (SFDC) and NetSuite.
* Review and validate sales orders against signed customer agreements, including customer information, products, pricing, billing schedules, and payment terms, to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Identify missing information, order discrepancies, and non-standard contract terms, escalating exceptions to senior team members or management as appropriate.
* Ensure transactions are processed in accordance with established billing procedures, company policies, and operational deadlines.
* Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation for sales orders, invoices, and billing transactions.

**Billing Inquiries and Dispute Resolution**

* Respond to internal and external customer billing inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Research billing discrepancies, invoice questions, and customer account issues.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to investigate billing discrepancies, resolve customer disputes, and ensure timely resolution of billing-related issues.
* Assist with processing billing corrections, credit memos, and adjustments in accordance with established procedures.
* Track outstanding billing issues and follow through to ensure timely resolution.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior team members or management.

**Reconciliations and Financial Close Support**

* Assist with reconciling third-party royalty and channel sales reports against internal order and billing data.
* Identify and research discrepancies between external reports and internal transaction records.
* Support month-end and quarter-end close activities, including reconciliations and assigned reporting tasks.
* Assist in preparing supporting schedules, transaction details, and documentation for accounting close activities.
* Ensure assigned deliverables are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

**Internal Controls and Compliance**

The Project Manager, Whole Person Health is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, management, and evaluation of projects and initiatives in the Whole Person Health portfolio. This role will focus on the continuous improvement of NACHC's PRAPARE ® (Protocol for Responding to and Assessing Patients' Assets, Risks, and Experiences) portfolio.

* Develop reports, presentations, and communications for leadership and stakeholder audiences.

* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, contractual requirements, and operational expectations, as applicable.
* Support development and implementation of sustainable processes, resources, and tools that advance organizational priorities.

2. Health Center Engagement and Technical Assistance

* Facilitate peer learning opportunities focused on PRAPARE® implementation challenges and best practices.
* Respond to PRAPARE ®inquiries and provide ongoing support and resources to participating organizations.

3. Training, Education, and Learning Collaboratives

* Design and manage national learning collaboratives, webinars, workshops, and conference sessions related to PRAPARE® implementation.
* Develop educational materials, toolkits, implementation guides, and training curricula.
* Coordinate faculty, subject matter experts, and advisory groups supporting PRAPARE® initiatives.
* Facilitate virtual and inperson meetings focused on social needs screening and intervention strategies.
* Promote dissemination of promising practices and innovative health center models.

4. Data, Evaluation, and Quality Improvement

* Support collection, analysis, and interpretation of PRAPARE®related data and related interoperability standards. (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD10CM, HL7® FHIR®, and Gravity Project)
* Support the development dashboards, reports, briefs, presentations, and infographics that communicate findings and impact.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen use of PRAPARE® data for population health management, quality improvement, and health equity initiatives.
* Support efforts related to data standardization, interoperability, and reporting requirements.

5. Stakeholder Engagement and Partnership Development

* Build and maintain relationships with health centers, PCAs, HCCNs, federal agencies, health information technology partners, communitybased organizations, and national stakeholders.
* Represent NACHC at conferences, meetings, workgroups, and national forums.
* Support development of strategic partnerships that advance PRAPARE® adoption and sustainability.
* Engage external stakeholders in collaborative efforts to address whole person health and community wellbeing.

6. PRAPARE® Licensing and Stewardship

* Manage the administration and oversight of PRAPARE® licensing agreements, including onboarding, renewals, and stakeholder communications.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for organizations seeking to adopt, implement, or expand use of PRAPARE®.

* Coordinate licensing processes and ensure compliance with PRAPARE® usage requirements and organizational policies.
* Build and maintain relationships with licensed organizations and partners to support adoption, sustainability, and effective use of PRAPARE®.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Master's degree preferred in Public Health, Health Administration, Health Informatics, Social Work, Public Policy, Healthcare Management, or a related field; relevant experience may be substituted for advanced education.
* Working knowledge of PRAPARE® and its application in community health center settings.
* Experience implementing or supporting PRAPARE within clinical, community health, or population health settings.
* Experience supporting implementation of screening, referral, care coordination, population health, or quality improvement initiatives.
* Experience supporting wholeperson health screening, assessment, referral, and community resource connection programs
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards and coding frameworks (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD10CM, HL7® FHIR®, and Gravity Project), and related interoperability standards.
* Experience working with electronic health records (EHRs), health information exchange, interoperability initiatives, or social needs data collection and reporting efforts.
