Job Description:

NetImpact Strategies is seeking an experienced **Information System Security Manager (ISSM)** to support a federal government project. This role is responsible for overseeing information system security compliance, developing and maintaining cybersecurity policies and procedures, and ensuring alignment with Department of War (DoW) security requirements and applicable federal cybersecurity standards.

The ideal candidate possesses strong knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks, exceptional written documentation skills, and the ability to translate complex security requirements into clear, actionable processes and procedures. This individual must be comfortable working directly with government customers, independently managing security compliance activities, and collaborating with technical and program teams to ensure security requirements are effectively implemented.

**Job Duties**

  

* Develop, document, implement, and maintain cybersecurity policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), security plans, and operational processes aligned with DoW directives and federal security requirements.
* Oversee information system security compliance activities, ensuring adherence to the Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST SP 800-53, and applicable DoW cybersecurity policies.
* Develop and maintain security authorization documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), risk assessments, and supporting authorization artifacts.
* Serve as a primary cybersecurity point of contact for government customers, providing security guidance, compliance updates, risk assessments, and recommendations.
* Coordinate with Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), system administrators, engineers, and project leadership to implement and maintain required security controls.
* Support Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities, continuous monitoring, security assessments, vulnerability management, and remediation tracking.
* Evaluate existing security processes, identify gaps, and develop practical improvements to strengthen compliance and operational efficiency.
* Prepare clear, comprehensive security documentation, reports, briefings, and recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Independently manage security compliance priorities, track deliverables, and proactively address risks or issues with minimal supervision.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years of experience in information systems security, cybersecurity compliance, information assurance, or related federal security roles.
* Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance for DoW/DoD or other federal government information systems.
* Strong knowledge of DoW/DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements, NIST SP 800-53 rev 5 security controls, and federal information security standards.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining cybersecurity policies, processes, SOPs, security plans, and compliance documentation.
* **Exceptional written communication and technical documentation skills**, with the ability to translate complex cybersecurity requirements into clear, actionable procedures.
* Experience preparing or maintaining SSPs, POA&Ms, security assessment documentation, and ATO-related artifacts.
* Strong customer-facing communication and interpersonal skills, including experience working directly with government stakeholders and technical teams.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, coordinate security activities, and ensure timely completion of compliance deliverables.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Experience using eMASS or similar security authorization and compliance management tools.
* Professional cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CAP/CGRC, or Security+.
* **Active Secret security clearance required.**
* Ability to work remotely within the United States.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience serving as an ISSM or senior ISSO on a DoW/DoD program.
* Familiarity with DoW/DoD cybersecurity directives, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and security control implementation requirements.
* Familiarity with DoD 8140 cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements.
* Experience supporting security audits, inspections, vulnerability assessments, and remediation activities.
* Experience developing cybersecurity governance frameworks, improving compliance processes, or standardizing security documentation across multiple systems.

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Threat Intelligence Team Lead to support a client's global security and risk management functions. In addition to the analytical responsibilities, as a Threat Intelligence Team Lead, you will oversee the team's day-to-day intelligence delivery, establish priorities, coordinate workloads, quality-assure analytical products, and provide coaching and mentorship to team members. You will serve as a key point of contact for client stakeholders, helping translate intelligence requirements into clear team priorities and ensuring the consistent delivery of timely, relevant, and high-quality intelligence.

* Produce and quality-assure timely intelligence products, investigative reports, alerts, and briefings, ensuring analytical accuracy, relevance, and consistency across team deliverables.

* Identify opportunities to continuously improve the intelligence function, including processes, analytical methodologies, tools, AI capabilities, and emerging technologies that enhance team effectiveness and intelligence delivery.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Experience supporting security, intelligence, investigations, trust and safety, or risk management programs within technology companies, government agencies, or private-sector intelligence organizations.
* Strong understanding of threat intelligence, investigative methodologies, threat actor research, intelligence collection and analysis practices, and online investigative techniques.
* Strong proficiency in OSINT collection, social media analysis, public records research, and commercial investigative and intelligence platforms such as LexisNexis, Dataminr, Flashpoint, or similar technologies.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and editorial skills, with the ability to assess risk, manage ambiguity, produce actionable intelligence, and quality-assure analytical products for accuracy, relevance, sourcing, rigor, and clarity.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop intelligence professionals while fostering collaboration, accountability, and consistently high analytical standards.
* Ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple intelligence requirements across a team, manage competing demands, and exercise sound judgment in dynamic or time-sensitive situations.
* Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate findings, understand client requirements, and translate those requirements

**Help Shape the Future of Britain's Railway**

Rail Delivery Group (RDG) partners with Britain’s train operators to put customers at the heart of everything we do, delivering essential services and dedicated experts who keep the nation’s railway running efficiently.

From journey information, reservations and Railcards to improving performance, safety and accessibility, we drive the services and people that keep the railway moving. Anyone who has travelled by train or booked a journey for friends or family, will have used our services. We are integral to the running of the railway and play a crucial part at every stage of the customer journey – making sure we are delivering a better railway for all our customers, now and in the future.  
  
As we embark on a new era for rail, we are now looking for a Project Manager to join us. If you are motivated by meaningful work and want to play a role in the future of Britain's railway, we'd love to hear from you!

What is the purpose of this job?

The Project Manager will play a key role in the successful delivery of the cEMV Programme, working alongside the Programme Manager and wider programme team to turn the programme’s strategic objectives into deliverable industry outcomes.

The programme is supporting the introduction and expansion of contactless “Pay As You Go” travel on rail, enabling rail to integrate effectively with regional contactless schemes and the wider account-based ticketing environment. A key part of this is the development of common industry standards that allow different suppliers, devices and systems to work together consistently and securely. The Standards workstream includes the development of the Front Office Device standard, associated interfaces and APIs, alongside testing, emulation and certification capabilities needed to demonstrate supplier compliance.

The post holder will primarily support the cEMV Standards workstream, taking ownership of projects and delivery activities across the development, review, testing and implementation of the standards. This will involve coordinating technical specialists, suppliers and industry stakeholders, managing plans and dependencies, and ensuring progress is maintained against agreed scope, timescales, budget and quality objectives. The workstream operates through structured governance and regular delivery cycles, with issues and decisions escalated through the appropriate programme forums.

The Project Manager will proactively identify and remove delivery blockers, drive actions to completion and ensure risks, issues and dependencies are actively managed. They will need to bring together technical and non-technical stakeholders, creating the structure and momentum needed to move complex areas from design and consultation through to agreed industry standards, testing and implementation.

The role requires strong stakeholder engagement across a complex, multi-organisational environment. The Project Manager will work collaboratively with internal teams, technical specialists, suppliers, train operators and wider industry partners to build commitment, coordinate activity and support effective decision-making. This is particularly important because the standards are intended to support interoperability across multiple suppliers and define clear requirements for areas including interfaces, security, testing and certification.

Project management at RDG is about balancing strong delivery disciplines with effective leadership and relationship management. As a Project Manager, you will lead from the front, bringing pace, structure and accountability to delivery. You will use project management disciplines, commercial awareness and strong people skills to drive outcomes, manage complex dependencies and help deliver the standards and capabilities needed to support the future of contactless Pay As You Go rail travel.

**What can I expect to do in this job?**

No two days are quite the same, but some of the things you will be involved in include:

* Taking ownership for the successful delivery of projects and workstreams within the cEMV Programme, ensuring agreed objectives are achieved.
* Driving delivery across multiple stakeholders and organisations, maintaining momentum and ensuring commitments are translated into action.
* Developing and maintaining robust project plans, schedules and delivery roadmaps, ensuring critical activities remain on track.
* Actively identifying delivery risks, dependencies and potential blockers, resolving them wherever possible before they affect project outcomes.
* Building strong relationships with train operators, suppliers, industry partners and internal teams to secure engagement and commitment to delivery.
* Leading project teams, coordinating contributions from stakeholders and subject matter experts, and creating accountability for agreed actions.
* Monitoring project performance against scope, schedule, budget and benefits, taking timely corrective action where required.
* Producing high-quality governance, reporting and decision-making materials that enable informed and timely decisions.
* Facilitating workshops and discussions that move projects forward, resolve issues and achieve consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Managing project change effectively, assessing impacts and ensuring delivery plans remain aligned with programme objectives.
* Supporting procurement, supplier management and contract delivery activities, ensuring suppliers deliver against agreed commitments.
* Working closely with the Programme Manager to identify opportunities, address emerging challenges and ensure programme objectives are achieved.
* Applying the RDG Project Delivery Framework and project management best practice to deliver measurable business outcomes and programme benefits.

assessment methodologies.

new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Manufacturing Operations exists to build and sustain the production system that enables Anduril to scale manufacturing with speed, quality, and discipline. We don't just support the factory. We are the operating system that makes it run. Our remit spans five pillars: the Anduril Production System (standard work, tiered accountability, KPIs, visual management), optimization and continuous improvement, learning and development, maintenance standards, and analytics. This role reports directly to the VP of Manufacturing Operations.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As Manufacturing Program Manager you will drive the cross-functional projects and initiatives that move Anduril from LRIP-era operations to a scalable Full Rate Production model. You will not own a single product line. Instead, you will be the program management engine across all five pillars of the Manufacturing Operations remit, ensuring that strategic initiatives have clear owners, defined timelines, cross-functional alignment, and measurable outcomes.

This is not a traditional project management role. It requires someone who understands manufacturing operations at the floor level and can drive accountability across engineering, supply chain, quality, IT, and leadership to get programs across the finish line.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

You will drive cross-functional projects and initiatives within each of the five areas that define the Manufacturing Operations remit:

**Build and Deploy the Anduril Production System**

* Drive the cross-functional rollout of standard work, tiered meeting structures (Tier 1/2/3), KPI definitions, and visual management across all manufacturing site
* Coordinate across Manufacturing System & Standards, site leadership, and IT/Digital to sequence deployment line by line and ensure each site is assessed, baselined, and brought to standard
* Build and operationalize the enterprise scorecard architecture (Plan vs. Actual, CTB Attainment, Downtime Pareto, Yield/DRR, OT%) so each level of the organization has the right metric at the right cadence
* Stand up and manage the Leadership SteerCo cadence that governs system priorities and holds the standard

**Get Technicians to Certified Operator Faster**

* Program manage the initiatives that cut time-from-hire-to-certified-operator, partnering with L&D on structured onboarding, skill certification redesign, and OJT overhaul
* Drive the cross-functional work between L&D, Talent Acquisition, and state/community partners (e.g., JobsOhio) to build a repeatable technician sourcing and hiring pipeline
* Ensure standard work is right-sized and OJT checklists map 1:1 to tasks so qualification is verifiable at every technician level
* Track and report on onboarding volume, certification timelines, and pipeline health across all sites

**Upskill Key Front-Line Leaders**

* Drive the buildout and cross-site deployment of supervisor and leadership training programs so the leaders closest to the line can run and audit the production system themselves
* Coordinate between L&D, site leadership, and the Optimization team to deliver leadership content and embed real-time coaching and mentoring across all sites
* Track program delivery milestones, cohort completions, and effectiveness metrics for Lead, Own, Grow and future leadership curricula

**Support and Optimize the Lines We Run**

* Coordinate the deployment of CI and optimization resources across sites, sequencing stabilization and optimization work against business impact
* Manage the CI project portfolio: track active deployments, gap assessments, kaizen events, and value stream mapping initiatives to ensure knowledge transfer sticks after each engagement
* Drive cross-functional alignment on NPI manufacturing readiness so new programs reach rate faster, partnering with Manufacturing Engineering and site teams
* Coordinate surge and recovery support when lines need additional capacity, ensuring the right resources deploy with clear scope and exit criteria

**Build Maintenance into the System**

* Drive the cross-functional standup of maintenance as a discipline within the production system: preventative maintenance programs, spare parts strategy, work order management, and technician skill development
* Coordinate the integration of maintenance KPIs (uptime, MTBF, MTTR, PM completion rate) into site-level scorecards and tiered meetings
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to define and document handoff criteria in the MDP/Launch Playbook so maintenance boundaries are clear from day one

**Across all five pillars:**

* Own the interfaces between Manufacturing Operations and partner organizations (Quality, ME, Supply Chain, IT/Digital, EHS) to keep boundary agreements current and escalation paths clear
* Standardize the work product for all outward reporting on behalf of Manufacturing Operations, ensuring leadership has consistent, quantitative visibility into program status, risks, and outcomes
* Drive resolution on open cross-functional governance questions (production scheduling ownership, shop-floor safety program ownership, MES system of record)

new_jobs.description:
**Operations Manager**

Rental Operations- Hayward, CA

**About Med One Group:**

Med One Group, a leader in the medical equipment rental and finance industry for over 25 years, is seeking a self-motivated Operations Manager to lead our distribution warehouse in Hayward, CA. This is a full-time, salaried position with a starting base salary of $80,000-$95,000, depending on experience.

In this role, you will oversee day-to-day warehouse operations while partnering closely with the Sales team to ensure exceptional customer service and operational excellence. The Operations Manager provides leadership, direction, and development to a team responsible for medical equipment processing, delivery coordination, scheduling, inventory management, and customer service.

**Essential Functions:**

* Thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Establish clear, measurable goals aligned with organizational objectives, ensuring strong alignment between people, processes, and strategy to drive consistent execution.
* Set high performance standards, hold teams accountable, and ensure full compliance with all policies and procedures.
* Lead by example by demonstrating a positive, committed approach to the business, colleagues, cross-functional partners, direct reports, and clients.
* Collaborate with Sales and leadership to deliver customer-focused, win-win solutions.
* Build and strengthen customer relationships in close partnership with the Sales team.
* Oversee facility operations, including warehouse and office organization, cleanliness, supply inventory, coordination with home office IT, business licenses, and relationships with local property management.
* Apply strong business and financial acumen by managing contracts and overseeing Profit & Loss (P&L) statements and budgets to support account profitability.
* Drive continuous improvement across processes, products, and services while embracing innovation, change, and adaptability.
* Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and emergency off-hours as business needs require.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to after-hours calls as needed to support staff and operations.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in warehouse operations, operations management, or a supervisory role.
* 3 to 5 years of leadership experience with a demonstrated ability to motivate teams, work independently, and take initiative. Experience in the medical equipment rental industry is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to build relationships and deliver excellent customer service.
* Proficiency with PC-based applications, excellent organizational skills, and strong attention to detail.

**Additional Information:**

Med One offers a great work environment with a team of dedicated coworkers who take pride in what they do. We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as a Health Savings Account partially funded by Med One. Additional benefits include life insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) plan through Vanguard, which employees are eligible to contribute to beginning on the first of the month following 30 days of employment. After one year of service, Med One matches 401(k) contributions up to 5%. We also offer paid time off, holiday pay, and a quarterly performance-based bonus.

If you're a motivated leader who thrives in a collaborative, customer-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you.
